item.title: Small- to mid-box supply shortage is supressing demand, report finds
item.description: Report from Potter Space and Savills finds that between 2014 and 2024 businesses would have taken 35% more space to meet their needs if it had been available, equating to 60m sq ft. The post Small- to mid-box supply shortage is supressing demand, report finds appeared first on Property Week.

item.title: Rightmove reports ‘strong financial performance’ as profits rise 12%
item.description: The property portal has launched a £90m share buyback programme, to be completed by the end of July, on the back of rising profits and revenue. The post Rightmove reports ‘strong financial performance’ as profits rise 12% appeared first on Property Week.

item.title: London flex market splits as managed offices hit 40% price premium, Rubberdesk reports
item.description: Average managed office desk rates were £230 above their serviced counterparts in Q4, but serviced space demand remained strong as operators cut prices. The post London flex market splits as managed offices hit 40% price premium, Rubberdesk reports appeared first on Property Week.

item.title: Black Sheep Coffee signs franchise deal to open 10 new central London sites
item.description: The firm plans to open 60 additional sites across London "in the coming years", a move that will more than double its footprint in the capital. The post Black Sheep Coffee signs franchise deal to open 10 new central London sites appeared first on Property Week.

item.title: PPHE repurchases Waterloo hotel almost a decade after sale-and-leaseback deal
item.description: This transaction is "another excellent illustration of PPHE's approach to capital allocation and capital recycling”, according to the group's co-chief executive. item.title: Kennedy Wilson and CPP commit £300m for single-family housing
item.description: The JV has exchanged contracts to acquire 788 units across 10 transactions. This brings the partnership’s platform to around 2,000 homes across 23 sites. The post Kennedy Wilson and CPP commit £300m for single-family housing appeared first on Property Week.

item.title: Chancerygate snaps up Birmingham site for 147,000 sq ft logistics development
item.description: The proposed scheme will comprise six leasehold units ranging from 12,000 sq ft to 47,000 sq ft. All units will target EPC 'A' and BREEAM 'Excellent' ratings. The post Chancerygate snaps up Birmingham site for 147,000 sq ft logistics development appeared first on Property Week.

item.description: Hillingdon Council appointed Strettons to market the building after moving its library services to a new building last April. The post Buckinghamshire New University buys Uxbridge Library for new campus appeared first on Property Week.

item.title: US cannabis giant seals cut-price BrewDog takeover
item.description: The £33m acquisition includes the group's UK brewing operations and 11 pubs in Birmingham, London, Aberdeen, Dublin, Edinburgh and Manchester. The post US cannabis giant seals cut-price BrewDog takeover appeared first on Property Week.

item.title: Edwin Coe hires Deepa Deb and NC Morris team
